about: Floors for the CI throughput smoke (benchmarks/throughput_smoke.py, ci.yml job throughput-smoke).
Each entry runs benchmarks/db_throughput.py at the smoke size (200k rows) and fails the job
below min_rows_per_second. rows/s is over the whole engine call, Gate-8 included; at 200k the
in-memory verification ladder runs too, so it is lower than a 1M run on the same route.
A floor sits well under the rate the route reaches on a hosted runner so runner noise does not
flap the gate, and above the rate of the code before the per-column fast paths (about 210 rows/s
